1.consolidated_definition: Un pajarito amarillo y ligero como copo de seda es conocido con el nombre de vigirita, formado probablemente sobre vedijita.
1.en_consolidated_definition: A small yellow and light bird, similar to a cotton ball, is known as the vigirita, possibly derived from vedijita.
